sections.heading: Mid-motor is a layout decision that you can inspect.
paragraphs: The SR10M places its Reedy 3300kV brushless system within a mid-motor G10 chassis arrangement. A sealed rear gear differential and externally adjustable slipper serve different drivetrain functions. The stock configuration gives a reference for setup work at a dirt oval, while it does not establish a measured cornering advantage at every surface. Keep the original motor position, battery restraints and prescribed gearing documented before altering them. The included pack is a 2S shorty format; a physically larger battery should not be forced into the retention system.

The documented Reedy 3300kV brushless motor is the power equipment evaluated for SR10M Dirt Oval LiPo Combo. With rear-wheel drive, available grip and trigger input need to work together. A harder trigger pull can ask more from the rear tires without improving the front wheels’ ability to turn. Start from the original 70033C gearing and battery specification. Keep optional electronics purchases separate until the stock configuration reveals a specific requirement worth changing.

sections.heading: Four radio channels do not decide the class rules.
paragraphs: The manufacturer specifies a four-channel 2.4GHz system with digital frequency hopping and a fitted digital metal-gear steering servo. Those are identifiable control components, not a measured latency or precision rating. Follow the supplied manual for binding and transmitter adjustments. The SR10M Dirt Oval LiPo Combo control system is listed as 2.4GHz 4-channel radio. Treat the manual as the reference for binding, reversing, neutral settings and any assistance function supplied with this exact package. Radio frequency alone does not establish compatibility with a replacement transmitter or receiver. Check steering trim on the surface you intend to use, then verify response in both directions before a demanding session. For organized use, ask whether assistance is allowed and whether battery or tire rules apply; the factory radio cannot answer the venue’s rules for you. If the car behaves incorrectly, distinguish a setting issue from physical binding. A new electronic part is a poor first response when the existing linkage is prevented from moving freely.

sections.heading: The carbon pieces and adjustable geometry support deliberate setup.
paragraphs: The SR10M features a carbon rear shock tower and side braces, oil-filled 12mm shocks, rear CVAs and adjustable geometry. A mid-motor layout and oval-oriented rear toe block make it more specific than applying a street-stock body to any RTR chassis. Preserve the baseline and ask experienced local drivers what changes are useful on the actual surface. Altering multiple roll-center, spring and tire settings at once can make the cause of a change difficult to follow. The useful tuning advantage is having a documented system to understand and repeat.

The published construction for SR10M Dirt Oval LiPo Combo is mid-motor g 10 chassis; carbon braces/rear tower;24 bearings. Those details describe what an owner can inspect and maintain; they do not provide a measured suspension or steering score. Use the original mounting positions as a reference and check movement before changing springs, shock positions or link lengths. Its listed wheelbase is 277.8 mm, which makes exact replacement compatibility more useful than a generic Team Associated parts search. Confirm tire clearance through steering travel and suspension movement with the body installed. Change one mechanical setting at a time, record the new position and return to the baseline if the result becomes confusing. A good tuning process should explain the change you are seeking, rather than replace several components at once and leave you unable to identify which one helped.

sections.heading: Street-stock tires need a known track surface.
paragraphs: The factory tires use a street-stock-inspired pattern and sit beneath a full stock-car body with integrated rear spoiler. They are documented equipment for the dirt-oval proposition, while a local track may require a particular tire or restrict preparation. The 536.4mm length and 250mm width demand a proper running area despite the comparatively narrow body. The SR10M Dirt Oval LiPo Combo tire package is Street Stock high-grip patterned tires. Its intended terrain listing is off-road and on-road. Begin on a surface that lets you observe a consistent response, then adjust the course rather than immediately blaming the tire.
